up: Find the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4699440' in the docs table. For each distinct molecule that appears in that document (linked via compound_records using doc_id and molregno), retrieve the molecule's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use a left join to compound_structures so that molecules without a SMILES are still included. Return one row per molecule. Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4699440' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
